kennel_club_uk.notes: Strongly built, short-coupled; broad skull with defined stop; jaws of medium length; broad and deep through chest; ears not large, hanging close, set rather far back; 'otter' tail.

ukc.length_to_height: equal to or only slightly longer (prosternum to point of buttock vs withers to ground)

photo_measurements_rough.method: Landmarks read off gridded side-view photos (Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0, measurement only). Close-range show photos: perspective error likely +-5 %.

length_to_height.why: between the standard (1.0-1.1) and real dogs in photos (1.2-1.3); plush reads better slightly compact

head_length_over_height.why: read from photos; firm up with more references
